title: Resolution urging Albany to defund animal testing entities
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation prohibiting state funds and tax benefits for any entity that engages in animal testing, breeds animals for testing, or transports animals for testing. It cites concerns about facilities like Marshall BioResources and animal research programs at CUNY, which receives state funding. The resolution follows New York's 2022 ban on selling cosmetics tested on animals.
